text: Toronto Parking Authority operates two (2) surface car parks in the northeast quadrant of the Yonge and St. Clair Avenue area. The car parks are located at 30 Alvin Avenue/1521 Yonge Street (Car Park 12) and 1501 Yonge Street (Car Park 223) and are operated on behalf of three (3) private land owners under contract arrangements that require updating. The purpose of this report is to provide an overview of the existing contractual arrangements under which Toronto Parking Authority is operating parking at these locations, provide an update on the performance of the car parks and seek Toronto Parking Authority Board of Director’s adoption of the confidential instructions included in Confidential Attachment 1.

The Board of Directors of Toronto Parking Authority: 1. Adopted the confidential instructions to staff in Confidential Attachment 1 to the report (July 12, 2022) from the President, Toronto Parking Authority. 2. Directed that Confidential Attachment 1 to the report (July 12, 2022) from the President, Toronto Parking Authority, remain confidential in its entirety, as it relates to a position to be applied to negotiations carried out by Toronto Parking Authority.
